title: Sand Splash Out The Bunker (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, sand is the easy shot if you know the trick
Dont hit the ball, hit the sand behind it
Splash it out, boy, splash it out

[Verse 1]
Open the face of the sand wedge, fifty six degrees
Open your stance fifteen degrees, feet in the breeze
Dig the feet two inches down for stability
Ball position off the lead heel, thats the ability

[Pre-Chorus]
Aim two inches behind the ball, son
Take a divot of sand, the splash is the work done
Full swing, full follow through, dont quit
The sand throws the ball out, you commit

[Chorus]
Sand splash out the bunker, son
Two inches behind, the dollar bill run
Open face, open stance, full commit
The ball rides the wave of sand to the fit

[Verse 2]
Greenside bunker shot, ten yards of carry
Full swing energy, sand absorbs, dont tarry
Fairway bunker different, clean strike thicken
Pick it cleaner, son, less sand quicken

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the bunker scares amateurs
But the pros love it, easiest up and down dappers
Commit to the swing, follow through full
Never quit on a sand shot, never lose pull

[Chorus]
Sand splash out the bunker, son
Two inches behind, the dollar bill run
Open face, open stance, full commit
The ball rides the wave of sand to the fit

[Outro]
Two inches behind, full follow through
Open the face, open the shoe
Splash the sand, ball flies free
Thats my boy, thats the key
